unary_lowering.reason: Do not invent S3 unary syntax without a repository-confirmed source fixture.

binary_precedence.reason: A dedicated precedence fixture must be copied from or validated against repository-supported S3 syntax.

comparison_lowering.reason: Current corpus exercises <=> inside while, but Stage04 still needs a focused expression-level comparison fixture before final qualification.

assignment_reassignment.reason: Existing fixtures exercise mutation in control-flow contexts; a focused Stage04 reassignment fixture is still preferred.

lexical_shadowing.reason: Shadowing semantics are too important to infer from an invented fixture; pin one from the Stage03/Stage04 candidate tests when Codex exposes it.

rule: PINNED means the laboratory already has a deterministic source input relevant to the capability; it is not PASS evidence until executed against an exact candidate with native provenance and strict S3 conformance. FIXTURE_NOT_YET_PINNED is a planning gap, not a compiler failure.
